item: Keywords never translated at any render site; custody actions worded
summary: Every esc(.term/.keyword/.kw) site in the UI modules now sits in a data attribute or a translate=no / data-i18n-dyn tag, as do keyword chart legends (labelIsData), the enlarge title, the slope and small-multiples labels and the super-group chips, so a corpus keyword equal to a locale key is shown as written; a structural test lists the sites and names any new unmarked one. The custody table words its 9 actions (unknown token shown as code) and its signature column (Ed25519, Ed25519 + ML-DSA-n); the Sig header, translated as significance, became Signature x12.
